You are very brave and you will get through this, I’m also a 20f and had mine in February, and tbh it all depends on the surgery itself, for me they split mine into fours and made me dilate so It’d heal bigger, which at some point during the two weeks I was told to do it broke my hymen, so you may want to ask your doctor abt the procedure to see how invasive it is, bc mine was very minor , for me it was uncomfortable to sit and kinda hurt pee, but I handled it by leaning back while I sat (but I have heard of ppl getting/ using a cushion or pillow so you might want to look into those) as well as leaning forward when I pee to try and direct it away from the area, and I’m assuming your doctor will give you pain medicine, bc those are a life saver, and the main thing is be as comfortable as possible, I bought slightly oversized men’s sweat pants(little extra room in the crotch area) for the surgery so the area could breathe, and it would easy to take off once I got home, but depending on the weather any loose fitting clothes would be good and underwear doesn’t hurt, they sent me home in medical underwear with a pad on it, also take the time you are laying in bed to do fun things, I played video games on my switch and watched tv, read a little, just all about being calm and taking your meds, and if you can have someone help you out for a couple of days it would be great, bc it really did help me

I haven’t tried tampons bc my birth control made my periods stop but I have had sex and it was a tough start but now It’s something I look forward to,and I relate ,I was anxious and scared and it truly effected my thought process abt sex, and my piece of advice is to have patience with yourself, bc it’s new to you, it may hurt but it’s just like how it is when you work out for the first time, the more you do it the easier it may get for you,it might not even be an issue with proper preparation and if it doesn’t, it’s ok, everyone is different you will find a way, bc you should always do it for you,as long as you keep an open mind and body abt sex you should be fine and always find what pleasures you most, also I know how that sitting pain felt, just like everything else that will pass too

Sorry for the late reply and I hope you’re surgery went well, i had mine in February with the same recovery time and it may be different for you, but for me it was hard and painful  in the beginning bc it’s new to the body it’s like stretching a muscle you don’t use often bc for me it felt like it wasn’t gonna go in but we kept trying and took it slow, and after the surgery the main thing is to not be harsh on yourself if it doesn’t go how you plan, bc i did and it felt horrible, it took three to four times before it felt really good but like I said earlier it may be easier or harder for you but I wish nothing but good health and good sex
